during each day of the novena our liturgy will have a speci/f_ic focus as follows: monday 2 november for deceased parents, grandparents and family members, whose love and caring shaped our lives. tuesday 3 november for refugees, migrants, and those displaced by con/f_lict or disaster, who died seeking safety and hope. wednesday 4 november for emigrants and those who died far from home, separated from loved ones but not from our prayers. /t_hursday 5 november for deceased clergy and religious, who dedicated their lives to serving god and others. friday 6 november for babies, children and young people who died too soon, leaving us with un/f_illed dreams and deep sorrow. saturday 7 november for those who died by suicide, and for the healing of families and communities affected by this loss. sunday 8 november for all who died in the last year, and for those who continue to grieve their absence. monday 9 november for victims of tragic accidents, unexpected deaths, and those lost in sudden circumstances. tuesday 10 november for those killed in war, violence, and natural disasters, and for innocent lives lost in global turmoil. november novena of remembrance at galway cathedral 2 november — 10 november
